items.statement: The supplied radical cation endpoint is checked as a stationary minimum before interpreting properties.
items.expected: The vacuum 2g•+ parent is a stationary minimum, supported by zero imaginary internal vibrational modes or inspectable equivalent evidence of stationarity and positive curvature in all internal nuclear directions. Optimization convergence alone is insufficient. Equivalent evidence is an accepted benchmark route, not a claim that the authors used it.

items.expected: The sulfur Hirshfeld spin population is 0.401.
